reuse.why: Adds one assertBankAccountNotLinked check that every provider link handler calls; it does not consolidate the five copy-pasted link functions, which is acceptable for this request.

duplication.why: Query and error message exist once; only the call is repeated at the top of each of the five link functions.

placement.why: Defined in accounts/app.ts next to the handlers, while accounts/link.ts already holds the shared link-time helpers (findOrCreateBank) and would be a more natural home.

scope.why: Only the guard and its five calls; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Simple and readable, though the provider is an untyped string and a new provider must remember to call the guard; no tests accompany the rule.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers call the guard before findOrCreateBank.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; repeated lines are calls to the single helper.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
